newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent futures up, flirt with resistance.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent futures up, flirt with resistance.

text.p: IPE Brent futures added to early gains and tested upside resistance in later trade on Thursday, but failed to make up Wednesday's sharp losses, brokers said.
December Brent crude was trading up 46 cents at $23.01 at 1600 GMT, partially reversing Wednesday's fall of 84 cents.
Brent briefly touched $23.03, but did not seem able to breach the key resistance level, pegged between $23 to $23.10.
Some saw Brent unlikely to return to recent highs.
"I think we'll explore lower levels, though we're not expecting a substantial collapse," one broker said. "Yesterday's sharp move changed a lot of minds around."
"The market should come off a lot harder and faster than it is," a further broker said.
January gas oil futures were off $3.25 at $220.50 a tonne.
Brokers said they expected gas oil to continue falling over the short term.
"I think we'll carry on seeing the market come off," a trader said. "We're going to turn around and look back and ask ourselves why didn't the customer sell the market."
The ongoing duel between AIC and Cargill over the November contract physical delivery continued to cast a shadow over trade, brokers said.
